description: Mux an already-uploaded video and audio file (both from get_upload_url) into one fresh-encoded output. Same conform methods and options as conform_from_url — use for local files or files too large to fetch by URL. Poll get_job_status until 'complete', then get_download_url.

audio_object_key.description: The object_key returned by get_upload_url for the audio source.

options.description: Same options object as conform_from_url (method, target_framerate, duration_policy, width, height, bitrate, audio_bitrate, h264_profile).

video_object_key.description: The object_key returned by get_upload_url for the video source.

name: conform_media

job_id.description: Unique identifier for this job. Pass to get_job_status and get_download_url.
